adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `createEvent` now selects `selectedCalendar` by matching `cal.credentialId === credentialId`, but still calls `calendar.events.insert` with `calendarId: selectedCalendar || "primary"`. If no `destinationCalendar` entry matches the passed `credentialId`, the event is created on the Google "primary" calendar without signaling failure. This is compounded by `packages/core/CalendarManager.ts` returning `externalId` from the caller (`createEvent(credential, event, destination.externalId)`), so the system can record a non-primary `externalId` even though the event was actually inserted into `primary`, leading to inconsistent references and likely broken update/delete behavior later.
